phase_title: 実測入力検証結果レポート設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力受領・検証層：Phase 16-4（形式検証）、Phase 16-2（完全性・署名・整合性検証）、Phase 16-5（証跡固定）の検証結果を統合し、実測入力データの検証が成功したか失敗したかを総合的に報告するレポート構造を設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of validation result reporting structure only, no actual validation result reporting yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Validation result reporting is design-only; no actual validation result reports are generated. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual validation reporting is performed.

validation_result_reporting_purpose.purpose: Create unified validation result report aggregating outcomes from all three validation layers (format, completeness/signature/consistency, integrity/evidence lock) and determining overall validation success or failure
validation_result_reporting_purpose.report_timing: Following completion of Phase 16-4, Phase 16-2, and Phase 16-5 validation procedures
report_inputs: Phase 16-4 format validation report (PASSED_FORMAT or FAILED_FORMAT)
Phase 16-2 completeness/signature/consistency validation report (PASSED_VALIDATION, FAILED_*, or PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS)
Phase 16-5 evidence lock verification result (LOCKED or TAMPERING_DETECTED)
report_outputs: Phase 16-7 unified validation result report determining: VALIDATION_PASSED, VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE, VALIDATION_FAILED_HALT, or VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS

aggregation_rule_1_format_required.condition: IF phase16_4_format_validation_final_status != PASSED_FORMAT THEN overall_result = VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE
aggregation_rule_1_format_required.rationale: If data format is invalid, cannot proceed to deeper validation; returnable to reviewer for reformatting

aggregation_rule_2_signature_critical.rule: Authentication validation (Phase 16-2 signature check) must be AUTHENTICATED
aggregation_rule_2_signature_critical.condition: IF phase16_2_authentication_status != AUTHENTICATED THEN overall_result = VALIDATION_FAILED_HALT
aggregation_rule_2_signature_critical.rationale: Authentication failure indicates potential tampering or security issue; must halt, not return

aggregation_rule_3_completeness_required.condition: IF phase16_2_completeness_status != COMPLETE THEN overall_result = VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE
aggregation_rule_3_completeness_required.rationale: Missing fields are correctable by reviewer

aggregation_rule_4_consistency_important.condition: IF phase16_2_consistency_status == INCONSISTENT THEN overall_result = VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE; IF CONSISTENCY_WARNING THEN flag as warning_present
aggregation_rule_4_consistency_important.rationale: Consistency failures are returnable unless they involve authentication

aggregation_rule_5_integrity_absolute.rule: Data integrity (Phase 16-5) must show LOCKED (hash verified OK)
aggregation_rule_5_integrity_absolute.condition: IF phase16_5_integrity_verification_status != LOCKED THEN overall_result = VALIDATION_FAILED_HALT
aggregation_rule_5_integrity_absolute.rationale: Tampering detected must halt immediately; not returnable

aggregation_rule_6_combined_pass_logic.rule: All validation layers must pass to achieve VALIDATION_PASSED
aggregation_rule_6_combined_pass_logic.logic: IF (format=PASSED AND signature=AUTHENTICATED AND completeness=COMPLETE AND consistency=CONSISTENT AND integrity=LOCKED) THEN overall_result = VALIDATION_PASSED; ELSE if warnings_present THEN VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS
aggregation_rule_6_combined_pass_logic.rationale: All layers must succeed; warnings are tolerable in PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS state

elements.validation_completed_timestamp: ISO8601 - when all validation layers completed
elements.total_validation_checks_performed: Count of all validation checks across 3 layers

elements.failing_fields: List of fields that failed format validation (if any)

elements.authentication_algorithm: Algorithm used (RSA-2048, ECDSA-256, JWT, MFA, etc.)
elements.authentication_issues: Any signature verification failures or weak algorithms

elements.consistency_check_results: For each check: PASS / FAIL / WARNING

elements.tampering_detected: If any hash mismatch or audit log issues found

logic.VALIDATION_PASSED: All 5 layers (format, completeness, signature, consistency, integrity) PASSED; no issues
logic.VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS: All critical layers passed, but warnings flagged (e.g., confidence-judgment mismatch)
logic.VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE: Format, completeness, or consistency failures; can be corrected and resubmitted
logic.VALIDATION_FAILED_HALT: Signature or integrity failures; cannot be corrected; requires halt/escalation

logic.HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS: If VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS but human review recommended

phase_16_3_integration.description: Connection to Phase 16-3 pre-decision update feasibility assessment

elements.validation_passed_sufficient_for_16_3: Is validation outcome sufficient for Phase 16-3 to proceed? (YES if VALIDATION_PASSED; CONDITIONAL if PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS)
elements.warnings_impact_on_16_3: Do warnings affect Phase 16-3 feasibility assessment?
elements.phase_16_3_readiness_condition: Phase 16-3 READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED condition: met if validation status in [VALIDATION_PASSED, VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS]

step_1_collect_validation_outcomes.action: Gather Phase 16-4, Phase 16-2 (all sub-checks), and Phase 16-5 validation reports
step_1_collect_validation_outcomes.prerequisite: All three validation layers must have executed

step_5_assess_consistency_layer.fail_criterion: INCONSISTENT → VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE; WARNING → flag as warning_present

step_7_aggregate_and_synthesize.action: Apply aggregation rules to determine overall_validation_result
step_7_aggregate_and_synthesize.logic: Synthesize outcomes from all 5 layers using aggregation_rule_1 through rule_6

step_8_determine_recommended_action.mapping: VALIDATION_PASSED → PROCEED; PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS → HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS or PROCEED; FAILED_RETURNABLE → REQUEST_CORRECTION; FAILED_HALT → HALT_AND_ESCALATE

example_1_passed.scenario: All validation layers pass; no warnings

example_2_passed_with_warnings.scenario: All critical layers pass; consistency has warning (confidence-judgment mismatch)
example_2_passed_with_warnings.next_step_after_review: If approved: PROCEED_TO_PHASE_16_8; If rejected: REQUEST_CORRECTION

example_3_failed_returnable.scenario: Format has missing fields; signature OK; integrity OK
example_3_failed_returnable.correction_required: Provide missing fields; reformat; resubmit via Phase 16-1

example_4_failed_halt.scenario: Signature verification fails; indicates tampering or authentication issue
example_4_failed_halt.escalation_reason: Potential tampering or authentication system compromise

example_5_failed_halt_tampering.scenario: Data integrity check detects hash mismatch; data may be tampered
example_5_failed_halt_tampering.escalation_reason: Data tampering detected; security investigation required

depends_on: Phase 16-2: Completeness, signature, consistency validation reports
feeds_into: Phase 16-8: Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility (receives validation result)
Phase 16-6: Failure handling (receives validation result if failed)

design_review_checklist: Aggregation logic covers all 5 validation layers (format, completeness, signature, consistency, integrity)
Format layer failure is flagged as RETURNABLE
Signature/authentication layer failure is flagged as HALT (not returnable)
Completeness and consistency failures are flagged as RETURNABLE
Integrity/tampering detection is flagged as HALT
Overall result logic correctly synthesizes layer outcomes
Recommended actions (PROCEED, REQUEST_CORRECTION, HALT_AND_ESCALATE, HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS) flow from overall result
Report structure aggregates findings from all three validation phases
Examples cover all five outcome scenarios (PASSED, PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS, FAILED_RETURNABLE, FAILED_HALT_SIGNATURE, FAILED_HALT_TAMPERING)
Phase 16-3 integration explicitly references validation outcome as readiness condition
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Validation result report design approved AND aggregation logic finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-8 (Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility) can begin once validation result design is approved
